newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: OUB Bank reports 19.7 pct rise in 1996 profits.
newsitem.headline: OUB Bank reports 19.7 pct rise in 1996 profits.

text.p: Singapore's Overseas Union Bank Ltd (OUB) said on Friday its net profit jumped 19.7 percent jump to Singapore $310.40 million (US$217 million) for 1996, up from S$259.33 million in 1995.

"The group's good performance was largely attributable to higher net interest income which saw a 23.2 percent increase to S$678.2 million, as well as fee and commission income which rose by 10.9 percent to S$142.6 million," the bank said in a statement.

The bank proposed a rights issue of 137.66 million new shares on the basis on one new share for every five existing shares held. It said the issue was designed to increase its capital base to support expansion.
The group had shareholders funds of S$3.2 billion at the end of 1996, it added.
"Successful completion of the rights issue will raise shareholders funds to almost S$4 billion," the statement said.
